defects.problem: Production mask input/RPC/history admitted1024 despite confirmed256-unit rule; composition end could commit a boundary-truncated surrogate and query Enter guard lacked composing ref.
defects.fix: Shared256 whole-codepoint UI clamp, well-formed query/mask RPC validation, invalid/oversized history not replayed; query/mask composition defers submission, Enter checks active composition, prototype matches same committed-state separation.

boundaries: A actual packaged App, original native authenticated search, trusted CDP text/key/input plus Chromium Input.imeSetComposition then browser commit. Chromium protocol compositionend may carry isTrusted=false; it is recorded and never claimed as physical OS evidence. This is browser IME pipeline, not physical system candidate/keyboard validation. Read-only event/model observation, no dispatched DOM events or Store/editor/result writes. Private fixture only, no model/clipboard/daily data.

P only: shared full FileWorkspace mounted with labelled synthetic files, real browser text/Chromium composition/keyboard. Host mounting/storage and host sizing are P fixture setup, no real file service, physical IME or pixel parity claim.

255/256/257 UTF-16 units and three complete-pair boundary samples, query/mask × ordinary/browser-composition × light/dark =48 actual App scenes. Original RPC/new request IDs and native results, no composition-time new request, old result not opened by Enter, sentinel source unchanged.

History reader excludes malformed or >256 legacy entries without rewriting storage on read. Explicit remember normalizes it; no truncated glob replay or fake user pattern. Schema rejects malformed query/mask rather than native serializer accepting split pairs.

All24 protocol-generated compositionend events are explicitly isTrusted=false; start/update/input/key are trusted. This is Chromium CDP composition functional coverage, never physical Chinese system candidate validation; C05 and all independent system/P/V cases remain unresolved.
No R01/R02/R18 or adjacent case marked passed by this batch. Pure U10+historyU2 and original registered-native dialog I16 new; remaining48 tests are regression, no new full-suite claim.

Local unsigned r58 six native smokes and runtime81 verified; no release authorization or external App/model/clipboard/daily AIS access. Original red and observation failure retained; final source archive only external driver differs from build.
